dedupe_keys.name: a high fidelity multi model benchmark dataset for general aviation anomaly detection generated via physics based fault injection

description: A High-Fidelity Multi-Model Benchmark Dataset for General Aviation Anomaly Detection Generated via Physics-Based Fault Injection is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jing Lu et al. Data-driven safety monitoring in general aviation (GA) faces a critical bottleneck: the scarcity of high-quality flight data containing verified anomalies, particularly across heterogeneous aircraft fleets. Existing datasets often lack physical realism or are limited to single aircraft models. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through the repository address listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from the Data Records or Data Availability section of the paper. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
